QuestInfo.name: Brokering for the Queen
QuestInfo.0: Go get a Diamond from #p9074203#, the Suspicious Merchant. #p9074203# is at the Oasis.
QuestInfo.1: #p9074203# will get you a Diamond, but he wants you to take revenge on all the #o9810201# who stole from him.

0.0: A-A customer?! It's been ages since I've even seen another human! What do you need? I'll pull a dolphin out of that pool if you tell me to!
0.1: A diamond for Queen #p9074201#?! Ah jeez, I wish you'd just asked for the dolphin. I stocked the pond with them about three months back and they just don't sell.
0.2: Wait, a DIAMOND? Are you going to propose?! No, you know what? No. You're a customer, you do what you want. I'll get your diamond, but I don't want cash. I just want a favor.

yes.0: The eastern path on the Desert Road is all blocked up because of the #o9810201# infestation. None of my customers can get through! Get rid of 100 for me and I'll get you that rock.

no.0: Good choice! You don't need to give diamonds to queens. They can get their own!

1.0: Alright, kid. You did the time, you can have the diamond. But I recommend you go see an eye doctor before you hand that thing over to #p9074201#!

mob.0: The eastern path on the Desert Road is all blocked up because of the #o9810201# infestation. None of my customers can get through! Get rid of 100 for me and I'll get you that rock.
